validator.source_text:
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml"
       xmlns:event="https://github.com/stateforward/scxml.rs/namespaces/event"
       version="1.0" datamodel="ecmascript" initial="idle">
  <state id="idle">
    <transition event="order" target="done"
                event:schema='{"$schema": "http://json-schema.org/draft-04/schema#", "type": "object"}'/>
  </state>
  <final id="done"/>
</scxml>

diagnostics.message: the inline schema of `<transition>` uses an unsupported JSON Schema dialect: unsupported `$schema` `http://json-schema.org/draft-04/schema#`
notes: the supported dialects are JSON Schema 2020-12 (`https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema`, the default when `$schema` is absent), 2019-09 (`https://json-schema.org/draft/2019-09/schema`), and draft-07 (`http://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema#`)
diagnostics.help: declare one of the supported dialects in `$schema`, or remove `$schema` to use 2020-12
